summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (after all_nodes), returning a new Graph with the Concise Bounded Description: triples whose subject is the resource, recursing into blank-node objects with cycle protection, plus reifications whose rdf:subject is the resource. Added testCBD, testCBDBlankNodes, testCBDBlankNodeCycle and testCBDReification to test/test_graph.py (and BNode import). Added cbd to the method list in docs/intro_to_graphs.rst. Tests and doctests were not run, per instructions; expected counts were checked by hand. Nothing committed. Not done: black was not added to requirements.txt, since the spec struck that part through.
